Restrained dynamic range, no HDR or shadow recovery. Realistic pores and skin variation, subtle sensor texture, slight lens softness and natural exposure imperfections.

85mm, f/2.0, ISO 100, 1/1000s, shallow depth of field, handheld full-frame photograph. Authentic unretouched daytime photography, no CGI, no plastic skin, no beauty-filter smoothing, no text or watermark.
